_about: Public places drawn on the map for everyone (layer 'Places', on by default). Add your own: name, lat, lon (decimal degrees), kind = city | campus | neighborhood | place. Do NOT put your home here; your home goes in .env (HOME_LAT/HOME_LON) and never leaves your computer. Restart with npm start after editing. Coordinates below were checked against OpenStreetMap Nominatim on 2026-10-09.
